artifact_types: raw result references and failure evidence
cost, duration, cancellation, and cleanup record
complete run configuration pinned to supplied frozen values, with placeholders only for unsupplied items
forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Experiment execution requires one exact reviewed definition and per-action provider authorization; any prompt, model, dataset, evaluator, metric, budget, transfer, or target drift invalidates or blocks the run.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: Frozen experiment definition, dataset version, evaluator versions, provider target, budget, and authorization.
outputs: raw result references and failure evidence
cost, duration, cancellation, and cleanup record
complete run configuration pinned to supplied frozen values, with placeholders only for unsupplied items
responsibility: Execute one reviewed frozen LLM experiment against exact dataset and evaluator versions under per-action provider-write, budget, and data-transfer authorization.
